Use case: ads-marketing. One square dramatic BLACK-GOLD Chinese ecommerce HERO AD artwork, no text. Inputs1 real silver front,2 real button/nozzle closeup,3 real silver side are appearance authority;4 gray side is curvature aid only;5 R004 STYLE ONLY for strong diagonal huge product, dark-to-gold contrast, sweeping gold silk light and red/gold bottom title rectangles. Do NOT copy R004's exploded structure, water, engine, blue energy or certificate. APPEARANCE AUTHORITY: Actual SILVER product photographs govern every visible product feature. Mirror-bright SILVER curved shell/handle, true round head with an identifiable cylindrical sidewall, shallow back flowing continuously into the long gently curved neck and calmer lower handle. No flat racket, abrupt shoulder, inflated bulb or extreme goose-neck. Black textured teardrop front panel with dense separate ivory WHITE nozzle rings, each one clean ring/one dark opening, original spacing, no fused rings, tails or ghosts; concentric tiny DARK perimeter holes. Original small RED center descaling control is a low wide flange plus smaller raised concentric boss and dark center opening, no oversized torus or new black pedestal. Lower separate rounded-rectangle selector is shiny SILVER inside black insert. Complete single showerhead ends in short bare SILVER threaded stub: REMOVE photographed hand, hose and quick-release connector; keep real handle. Clean polished photographic highlights, not matte CG steel. Do not introduce hands/people, water, spray, hose, mount, accessories, filters, internal machinery, certificates, logos, brand, text, numerals or claims. All graphic bars/capsules below must remain entirely EMPTY; typography will be composited later. Actual photo appearance overrides model/style product. Gray model is only broad side-curvature aid.
Distinct composition: one huge intact actual SILVER showerhead with large black circular face in UPPER-LEFT (head centered approx x360,y310), full curved handle runs diagonally DOWN-RIGHT toward short silver thread around x920,y965. Hero tilted opposite to a lower-left-handle/upper-right-head layout; entire real product complete and uncropped above banner. Visible silver cylinder thickness and flowing neck, wide-angle drama WITHOUT distorting proportions. Rich nearly-black/deep espresso backdrop, abstract flowing GOLD SILK LIGHT ribbons sweeping horizontally behind the product through midframe and lower-right, luminous gold gradient near lower background; elegant rippling ribbon forms only, not water, magic energy or internal engine. Strong crisp silver rim highlights, warm rim accent while body stays silver. Dense assertive marketplace ad, not a sparse catalog, and NO tray or rocks.
One subordinate close-up window in RIGHT side around x925..1215,y360..690 with softly rounded corners, a thin muted gold border and shadow: real RED center button and surrounding individual WHITE nozzle rings on black face; original low flange shape, no new black pedestal. The inset is much smaller than hero and must not conceal any part of the full hero item. Quiet upper-right dark pocket around x850..1210,y65..270 reserved for a short later gold headline, no text drawn.
MANDATORY LOWER TITLE DESIGN inspired by R004: bottom18% y1030..1254 a bold retail banner, LEFT approximately34% rich deep RED rectangular label, RIGHT66% luminous champagne GOLD rectangle, with clean slight layered overlap/shadow. Entire banner EMPTY for later very large black/white Chinese title. No icons, certificates, small type, internals or water. Capture R004's forceful gold-light diagonal emphasis and retail headline hierarchy, while all technical/unsupported visual claims are omitted.
